known.summary: `run` gives `execFile` the option `shell: process.platform === "win32"`. So on Windows, Node joins the arguments into one command line without quotes, and `cmd.exe` parses it. The `scratch_remove` tool checks only that each path is absolute, then gives the paths to `run` through `runDocksKit`. A path such as `C:\Temp\x & <command>`, from the agent or from text that the agent read, so runs `<command>` as the user (CWE-78, command injection). The doc comment of `run` promises no shell and one literal argv entry for each argument, and `resolveDocksKit` accepts only `docks-kit.exe` because the call has no shell. The pull request adds hygiene.ts: the base has no such file, no omp extension folder, and no helper that runs docks-kit or another command for an omp tool.
